tell: Hepatic metabolism accounts for about 85% of elimination, and its main circulating metabolite, triazole, is inactive.

clues.text: Orally administered drug is well absorbed, and food slows absorption without reducing its extent. It is 40% bound to plasma proteins, and hepatic metabolism accounts for approximately 85% of elimination.
Molecular weight 293.4. It has moderate aqueous solubility, independent of pH in the physiological range.
Approved under an NDA, supplied in bottles of 30 and taken once daily.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated with hypersensitivity to the drug or its excipients; hot flashes and arthralgia are among the common reactions, at 10% or more.
Adjuvant treatment of early hormone receptor-positive breast cancer, first-line treatment of locally advanced or metastatic disease, and advanced disease after tamoxifen, all in postmenopausal women.
A selective non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor that blocks conversion of androgens to estrone and estradiol, lowering serum estradiol without affecting adrenal corticosteroids or aldosterone.
The generic name begins with A and has eleven letters.
